title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Event group chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, Pro licensing, default state and general meeting-chat controls are supported. Two minor qualifications remain: the events-chat documentation covers more than town halls, and another Learn planning page still contradicts the documented Android presenter support.

claims.claim: Android Rooms acting as organisers, co-organisers or presenters in structured meetings or webinars gain access to the private Event Group chat.
claims.quote: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group.
claims.fix: Add this qualification in What's changing: "Learn's Plan for Teams events page still says only Teams Rooms on Windows with a Pro licence are officially supported to join meetings and events as presenters or attendees, conflicting with the Android support described by the roadmap and Android release notes." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/plan-events#reference, whose footnote states: "Only Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with a Pro license are officially supported to join meetings and events as a presenter or as an attendee."

claims.claim: Android release build 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 documents the Event Group and attendee-chat switching capability for town halls.
claims.quote: When a Teams Rooms on Android device is an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a town hall, you have access to a private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees enabling smooth event experiences for all.

claims.claim: Build 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 is listed under September 2026.
At the time of writing, the Android release notes contain no equivalent Event Group chat entry for webinars or structured meetings.
claims.quote: Searched: rooms-release-note full text for chat, Event Group, webinar and structured. Opened Android entries through October 2026; the Event Group chat entry names town hall, while the webinar/structured-meeting entry describes front-of-room view control.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn lists attendee meeting chat for events optimized for large audiences as unavailable on GCC, GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: The following limitations apply to meeting chat in events optimized for large audiences: ... Chat isn't available on the GCC, GCCH, and DoD government clouds at this time.

claims.claim: The events-chat page discusses town halls, so its large-audience chat limitations may not apply to this change.
claims.quote: Chat in events with up to 1,000 attendees, such as webinars, uses the same experience as chat in Teams meetings. ... In events optimized for large audiences, such as town halls, the chat experience differs depending on the event role.
claims.fix: Replace "That page is about town halls, so it may not apply here; confirm before telling government-cloud users to expect the tab" with "That restriction appears under attendee meeting chat for events optimized for large audiences, rather than a statement about this Android presenter-chat feature; confirm before telling government-cloud users to expect the tab." The cited page also covers webinars, not just town halls.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is configured in Teams admin center through Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote: go to **Meetings** > **Meeting policies**. ... Select the policy you want to edit. ... Go to the **Meeting engagement** section. ... Set **Meeting chat** to your chosen value

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled to disable meeting chat.
claims.quote: in order to set the value of MeetingChatEnabledType to Disabled, you will need to also set the value of LobbyChat to disabled. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled
